name: Save Eastside Library
tagline: Forty years of stories. Help us write the next chapter.
footer_text: Paid for by Friends of Eastside Library.

hero.headline: Every neighbourhood deserves a library
hero.subheadline: For forty years Eastside Library has been where our children learn, our elders get online and everyone gets warm. The council plans to close it next spring. This is why we are fighting for it.

donate.title: Keep the doors open
donate.impact: £10 a month keeps the homework club stocked with books.

cta_band.headline: Help write the next chapter
cta_band.text: Join hundreds of neighbours giving monthly to keep Eastside Library open.
